title: Interparfums' Q3 sales flat, as European operations offset US decline
summary: Interparfums Inc. reported stable third-quarter net sales of USD 430 million, unchanged from the same period last year. For the first nine months of the year, sales increased by 1% to USD 1.115 billion, compared with USD 1.102 billion in 2025. European-based operations recorded a 4% increase in third-quarter sales to USD 306 million, while US-based operations declined by 7% to USD 127 million. The company attributed the US decline largely to supply chain disruptions that delayed shipments... - Industry buzz
